text:
jess.marketing: Hey team — last check before we lock press: can runtime run a reproducible mini-cohort so marketing can cite conservative p50/p95/p99 for the launch blog + webinar? Need methodology note included. cc @sam.runtime @omar.eng

sam.runtime: Sure. Quick clarifying Qs: which quant profile and baseline, cohort size, sample slices, and deliverables? Also do you want cache=on to match prod?

jess.marketing: Use quant profile q4_2-release, baseline fp16. Cohort N=72 (we want slightly larger tail sampling). Include slices: interactive, long-context (>3k), and short. Seed=4242. Keep prefix/KV cache=ON for primary run and include a small coldstart slice cache=OFF --warmup 0 (N=12) for the heatmap. Deliverables: CSV with per-slice p50/p95/p99 and bootstrap CIs, estimated $/1M tokens, coldstart heatmap PNG, 25 anonymized raw traces, run_config.json, and a one-paragraph methods blurb we can paste into the blog footnote. Artifacts embargoed until launch; place in /share/marketing/bench/1755551111/ and mark as embargoed. Deadline: Friday 17:00 PT.

omar.eng: We can run that. Note q4_2-release tends to underperform in the extreme >4k tail; we'll include delta vs fp16 and bootstrap CIs. Also confirm tokenizer version.

jess.marketing: Tokenizer: rwd-tokenizer-v4. Model: redwood-alpha-8k@rev24. Please compute cost using internal-pricing-2026 and include assumptions (avg tokens/sample).

kai.metrics: Methodology note: please include how we compute CIs (bootstrap N=1000), the price table name, and runner warmup defaults. We'll want the exact seed and run_config.json to reproduce.

sam.runtime: Plan: enqueue cohort=mini72 seed=4242 model=redwood-alpha-8k@rev24 tokenizer=rwd-tokenizer-v4 variants=\"q4_2-release,fp16\" context=8192 batching=auto cache=on tags=marketing,embargoed,priority. Then coldstart slice: cache=off --warmup 0 N=12. We'll produce CSVs, JSON traces (anonymized), PNG heatmap, run_config.json, and methods.txt. ETA: start 06:00 UTC tomorrow; est runtime 3h. If queue pressure, we'll run a prioritized N=36 pass for percentiles and heatmap and then backfill traces.

sam.runtime: enqueue command:
```
enqueue-bench --cohort mini72 --seed 4242 --model redwood-alpha-8k@rev24 --tokenizer rwd-tokenizer-v4 --variants \"q4_2-release,fp16\" --context 8192 --batching auto --cache on --tags marketing,embargoed,priority
```

artifact-bot: :white_check_mark: Job queued: #3782 by sam.runtime  status: pending runners (https://rundashboard/jobs/3782)

sam.runtime: We'll annotate artifacts with warmup counts per host and include a pseudonym map for traces. We'll compute bootstrap CIs (1000 resamples) and include delta columns vs baseline. Cost calc will reference internal-pricing-2026 and show per-variant assumptions.

jess.marketing: Great. Please scrub any hostnames and replace user IDs with pseudonyms. Also add a short conservative line for press: \"Latency measured in production-like settings; see methods footnote for sampling and seeding.\"

omar.eng: Will do. We'll also include an appendix CSV with per-sample latencies so marketing can pick representative traces if needed.

sam.runtime: Noted. Upload path: /share/marketing/bench/1755551111/. I'll ping here when artifacts land and attach run_config.json and methods.txt.

jess.marketing: Thanks all 9really appreciate the fast turnaround. Please tag me when uploaded so I can lock copy for the blog and webinar slides. :sparkles:
